ios.desc:
See tomorrow before it arrives.

Tomoz pulls tomorrow's events from your calendars into one clean, distraction-free preview — so you can plan tonight instead of scrambling in the morning.

WHAT YOU GET
• A focused view of tomorrow's events, pulled from whichever calendars you choose
• Colour-code calendars to spot what's what at a glance
• Export tomorrow's schedule as Markdown, JSON or CSV
• Share via Mail, Messages, AirDrop or save to Files
• Siri Shortcuts — "What's on tomorrow in Tomoz?" gets you a spoken summary, hands-free
• Deep links for automations: trigger an export every evening, or get a morning briefing read aloud

ADD YOUR REMINDERS
Unlock the Reminders Add-on (one-time purchase) to see your tasks sitting alongside tomorrow's calendar events — one view for everything you need to know.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your device. Tomoz never sends your calendar or reminders data to a server.

Enjoying Tomoz? You can leave a tip to support development — entirely optional.

Privacy Policy: https://thechels.uk/app/privacy
